question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Dainty
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dainty"** means something that is delicately small and pretty. It often refers to something that is both attractive and delicate. (नाज़ुक और सुंदर)

 
 
• **Example:** She picked up the **dainty** teacup with her fingers, marveling at its intricate design.
 
 
 
• **"Elegant"** refers to something that is graceful and stylish in appearance or manner. It often conveys a sense of refined beauty. (शालीन)
 
 
• **Example:** The ballroom was decorated in an **elegant** style, with chandeliers and beautiful drapes.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'dainty'** is **'elegant'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vulgar** (अश्लील): Lacking sophistication or good taste; unrefined.

 
 
• **Example:** His** vulgar** jokes made everyone uncomfortable.
 
 
 
• **Fine** (अच्छा): Of high quality; very good of its kind.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist created a** fine **piece of artwork.
 
 
 
• **Sable** (काले रंग का): A very dark or black color.
 
 
• **Example:** She wore a **sable** coat to the event.
